title: anneal design tree
description: The questions a grilling asks, kept by the grill skill. `anneal grill frontier --tree <file>` lists the open questions whose dependencies are all answered; `anneal grill confirm` records the human's confirmation of the tree's hash. Checked by crates/anneal-cli/tests/it/design_tree_schema.rs, which keeps this schema and the serde DTO in agreement. Beyond the schema, anneal rejects a depends_on cycle, a dependency naming no node and two nodes with one id.

goal.description: What is being grilled, in one line.

turns.description: One entry per round of questions, oldest first. The restate gate fires when the latest confidence is 0.8 or more, or after 3 turns in a row that did not beat the best confidence before them.

confidence.description: Confidence in the shared understanding after the round, from 0 to 1.

question.description: The question, as it would be asked.

depends_on.description: The ids of the questions whose answers this one needs first.

status.description: open: not settled; answered: the answer is agreed; deferred: set aside, with the answer as the assumption.

answer.description: While open, the recommended answer a plain "yes" accepts; once answered, the agreed answer; while deferred, the assumption carried.

is_decision.description: The probability, from 0 to 1, that only the human can settle this (a decision) rather than the model looking it up (a fact). At 0.5 or more the question is asked, with its recommended answer; below, it is looked up. Clef D7 (#32) writes its estimate here.

confidence.description: The model's confidence in the answer, from 0 to 1.
